newsitem.title: UK: London precious metals wind down for the year.
newsitem.headline: London precious metals wind down for the year.

text.p: Precious metals trading wound down for the year in Europe on Tuesday afternoon after silver was fixed sharply lower.
There will be no afternoon gold, platinum or palladium fixes on December 31. Fixings will resume after the New Year holiday on Thursday morning.
"There has been very little business today. People are going to hand over their books to New York and drift off after the silver fix," a dealer said.
Silver was fixed at 479.75 cents, against 488.00 cents previously, following Monday's New York-led sell off. It was consolidating around the nearby support level of 480 cents.
Earlier in the day gold was fixed at $369.55 an ounce, little changed from Monday afternoon's fixing of $369.25.
Platinum was indicated at $370.00/$371.00, up $1.50 from Monday's close but virtually unchanged on the day.
